benchmark_metadata.sampler: sequential; target rate is an upper bound

availability_and_failover.rpo: not measured; this read-only test does not validate database replication
availability_and_failover.measurement_note: Survivor streak is a client estimate, not ALB health detection or guaranteed RTO. Disruption span is first-to-last failed sample, which can be zero for one error. Stable resumption measures first error to a successful survivor streak (either healthy zone after recovery). Absence of samples cannot prove availability.

limitations: No AWS health snapshots or video collected by this client.
Local simulation changes health only; it does not stop an EC2 instance.
Sequential sampling can miss short disruptions and cannot guarantee offered load.
